notes: Audit date 2026-10-11; 12 records audited. Bucket counts: recurring_next_intake_expected 7 (ids 71, 204, 248, 290, 317, 402, 609); temporarily_closed_awaiting_announcement 2 (ids 134, 661); upcoming_or_current_intake 1 (id 449, low confidence); uncertain 2 (ids 360, 704); genuinely_discontinued 0. Key reviewer caveats: (1) ids 449, 360, 704 could not be verified live - all listed suss.edu.sg URLs returned HTTP 403, the Embassy of Japan in India page returned HTTP 403, and both hec.gov.pk URLs returned transport errors; only the JASSO studyinjapan.go.jp MEXT page was readable and it states no intake status. Their classifications rest on the records' prior local evidence, marked low confidence. (2) For id 290 (NAWA) the linked 2026 announcement PDF returned unreadable binary to the fetch tool, so the 2026 call's exact submission deadline was not re-verified from the page; the classification relies on the announcement itself (No 19/2026 of 30 April 2026), the programme's 'Closed calls'/'Call results' history and previous-year announcement links. (3) For id 134 (unibo), no 2026/27 International Talents edition exists in the portal's open list or 2026 expired-calls archive (pages covering all expiry dates through ~May 2026 inspected), 499 days after the last deadline - recurrence could not be evidenced from the pages, hence closed-awaiting-announcement rather than recurring. (4) For id 609 (KDI), the record's official_urls list includes non-awarding-body URLs (aims.ac.za, sutd.edu.sg); per the awarding-body-only rule these were excluded and the KDI School official_source_url plus the KDI admission calendar (same official domain) were used. Similarly, non-awarding-body URLs in lists for ids 134 (siss.it, uts.edu.au), 290 (anr.fr, china-embassy, sutd.edu.sg, aims.ac.za) and 661 (study.csp.work et al.) were excluded. (5) id 661 (Aurora) page states 'Up to four scholarships will be awarded yearly from 2024 to 2026' - the 2026 round is closed with no announced next date; the funding horizon may indicate conclusion after 2026, so re-check in 2027. (6) Logos are included only where the image URL was fetched and rendered from the awarding body's own domain: UCL, HEA/Government of Ireland, NAWA, Tsinghua yz, Rhodes Trust, KDI School, Aurora. (7) No records show authoritative evidence of discontinuation; no deadlines, amounts, departments or logos were invented - unverifiable fields are null with the reason in page_evidence.
